invariants: Cognigrex is the proper noun for the complete living parent filespace/intelligence architecture.
Römer-Grex, Eco-Grex and LightSpeed/EMC² are tailored child systems, not alternate names for Cognigrex.
Child domain authority does not become parent authority merely because the child is mounted.
Cross-domain links reference child objects by stable identity; state is not copied for convenience.
Runtime evidence such as leases, heartbeats, host conformance runs and transient app handoffs remains Host-local unless explicitly promoted.
CCC is shared at the parent/kernel layer rather than duplicated inside each sister.
EMASSC.cgx owns scientific/governance/methods context; LS.cgx owns execution/runtime semantics.
A child may later be EMBED, TRACK, PIN or REFERENCE according to deployment/security needs without changing its semantic identity.
Assurance methods remain distinct analytical lenses; FMEA, MPL, hazard, cyber, ecological and custodial reasoning must not be collapsed into one sovereign score.

bridging_rules: Programme child identity is not independent CGX root, public authority, transport privilege or agency endorsement.

FileSpace owns stable Object_ID, source rights, model and geometry roots and DBR; DataSpace is authorised sparse interoperation; PrintSpace is qualified physical manufacturing and measured-return evidence.
SAI node capacities and security classes are independent; vital deterministic OT and local essential services take precedence over discretionary AI/federation.
Römer owns the programme engineering domain; Eco-Grex ecological qualification, EMASSC research/IP custody, Raphael scientific/PrintSpace evidence and LS runtime preserve scoped owner authority.
One static context may produce many local semantic projections, but cannot convey unknown information without evidence, caching or a permitted retrieval path.
National public research discovery must not impersonate Australian authorities or use SOS/public emergency alert pathways except via specifically authorised systems.
No public route, private node roster, site-sensitive geometry, radio access, real peer exchange, model truth or material readiness implied by this crosswalk.
